title: Differential Score Alerting for Safe Model Rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: build a differential scoring and alerting system that automatically detects quality regressions between a baseline (currently serving) model and a candidate model during canary/A-B/shadow rollouts, and drives automated safeguards (pause/cancel/rollback) when significant regressions are observed.

Scope: compute per-prompt and aggregated score deltas using our golden prompt sets + live shadow traffic samples; surface statistical significance and effect size on a scorecard; feed discrete gating decisions into the rollout controller. Support streaming and batch eval modes, configurable alert thresholds, and human-review workflows for ambiguous signals.

Design decisions and trade-offs: we opted for a two-stage signal pipeline: fast online heuristics (approximate metrics on sampled shadow/A-B responses) for immediate short-window gating, and slower high-confidence batch re-eval against the full golden set for definitive actions. This balances false positive risk with time-to-detect. We are experimenting with Bayesian credible-interval thresholds (instead of fixed z-score) to reduce flip-flopping on low-volume rollouts.

Integration points: rollout-controller API (canary.pause/canary.abort), Console scorecard dashboard, alerting (PagerDuty/Slack), Eval ingestion pipeline (golden-set storage), and CI hooks for PR-based pre-rollout checks.

Performance/cost considerations: scoring every live request is expensive; we use stratified sampling + KV-cache of reused prompts and incremental scoring for repeated prompts to control egress and compute cost. For Dedicated customers we allow an opt-in high-sensitivity mode with higher sampling and stricter thresholds.

Acceptance criteria: (1) differential signal computed within 2 minutes for canaries with >=250 sampled responses, (2) automated pause on high-confidence regressions (customer-impact: medium/high) with clear reversible actions, (3) scorecard visible in Console with per-prompt drilldowns and links to example responses, (4) integration tests covering synthetic regressions and non-regression noise tests.
comments: 2026-02-22: Spike complete. Validated metric set (accuracy/prob calibration/semantic-similarity/rank correlation) on golden prompts. Trade-off: similarity metrics are heavy — use them for batch gating only.
2026-02-28: Prototype end-to-end pipeline in staging: shadowed 10% traffic, computed deltas, generated synthetic alert for PR #5567. Initial false positive rate ~7% — tuning thresholds next.

2026-03-03: Sync with PM Jonah Kerr and Data Science (Marta Lopez). Decision: adopt credible-interval based thresholds + minimum sample size of 250. Added per-prompt bucket labels to handle known flaky prompts.

2026-03-05: Integration test suite added: regen-responses harness and canary controller mock. Found race when rollout controller retries a paused canary — mitigation: idempotent pause API changes in GH PR #5591.

2026-03-10: Load test: scoring pipeline sustained 4k evals/min on staging with autoscaling rules. Observability: Console dashboard draft at https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/eval-diff (internal). Next: add human-review workflow and PD escalation paths.
